verification_method: PARTIAL_FILE_AUDIT - direct Zenodo file browsing was blocked this sprint (curl to zenodo.org timed out twice, ~15-20s each, from this sandbox's network egress). Verification instead used the peer-reviewed paper's own directly-fetched text, which reports MEASURED (not nominal/advertised) per-signal sample rates and a per-participant completeness table - i.e. the authors' own actual-file audit, reused rather than re-derived blind from an abstract.

devices: Galaxy Watch 5 (PPG 25 Hz, ACC 25 Hz, temp 1/60 Hz)
Empatica E4 (BVP 64 Hz, ACC 32 Hz, temp 4 Hz)

per_device_completeness.galaxy_watch5_hr_derived: 21/24 (P07, P08 also missing HR - NOT relevant to this project's use, since Galaxy Watch derived HR is EXCLUDE_LEAKAGE and never a candidate input)
per_device_completeness.polar_h10_ecg: 24/24 (complete) - the reference signal this project actually needs
per_device_completeness.e4_skin_temperature: 23/24 (P02 missing) - out of scope, not used

actual_file_facts.file_format: CSV, hierarchical by participant ID and device
actual_file_facts.license_access: CC BY 4.0, open access (no credentialing) per the paper text

usable_cohort_for_this_projects_experime.eligibility_rule: Require E4 BVP present AND E4 ACC present AND Polar H10 ECG present (data-quality rule only, not outcome-based)
usable_cohort_for_this_projects_experime.excluded: None - all three signals this project actually needs (E4 BVP, E4 ACC, Polar ECG) are reported complete for all 24 participants. The two data-quality issues in the source (P01 Galaxy Watch config error, P02 E4 temp missing) do not affect this project's candidate signals.
usable_cohort_for_this_projects_experime.caveat: This 'all 24 usable' conclusion is derived from the paper's stated per-signal completeness, not from this session directly opening and checking all 24 participants' raw CSV files (blocked - see verification_method). Stage 2 must re-verify file-by-file before finalizing the eligibility table, per this project's actual-file-over-secondary-source discipline.

synchronization.note: Cross-device timestamp synchronization method (shared clock, manual alignment marker, etc.) was not confirmed from source text retrieved this sprint.
